name: Sentry Setup
deliverable: Error monitoring wired up, a test error received, and the dashboard linked to your project.
selfServiceAlternative: Shipyard can install this itself and walk you through creating the account. Most people manage it in about twenty minutes.

name: Domain and SSL Setup
deliverable: Your domain connected, HTTPS verified, and the DNS settings written down so you can change them later.
selfServiceAlternative: Your deployment provider can do this from its dashboard. It is fiddly rather than hard.

name: Payment Integration Review
deliverable: A developer reads the billing code: webhook signatures, repeated messages, what happens when a card is declined, and whether people get what they paid for.
selfServiceAlternative: The automated payment checks cover the common faults. This is for when real money is about to move and you want a person to have looked.

name: Launch Readiness Audit
deliverable: A written report: what is ready, what is not, what would happen if you launched anyway, and a launch decision.
selfServiceAlternative: Your readiness score already lists every blocker with a next action. This is a person checking the things a test cannot.

name: Manual QA Pack
deliverable: A test plan, a full run through it by hand, every issue written up, and an automated set that catches them next time.
selfServiceAlternative: Ask Claude to write browser tests for your main journeys. This is for when you want someone to try to break it on purpose.

name: Security and Privacy Review
deliverable: Findings, the fixes, a plain-language note on what risk remains, and a referral to a lawyer where the answer is not technical.
selfServiceAlternative: The automated scans catch known holes. They cannot tell you whether what you are doing with people's data is lawful where you operate.

name: Fix Sprint
deliverable: A developer fixes one scoped problem and leaves a test proving it stays fixed.
selfServiceAlternative: Keep going with Claude. This is worth it once the same problem has survived two attempts — that usually means the cause is somewhere other than where it appears.

name: MVP Completion
deliverable: A fixed scope, taken to pilot-ready by people who are accountable for finishing it.
selfServiceAlternative: Everything here is something you can reach yourself. This is for when a date matters more than the saving.

name: Operate Plan
deliverable: Monitoring watched, updates applied on a schedule, incidents triaged, and a person to ask.
selfServiceAlternative: Shipyard will keep showing you incidents and readiness for free. This is for when you would rather not be the one who notices.

name: Legal Referral
deliverable: An introduction to a solicitor who works on automated decision-making, and a summary of your situation for them to read first.
selfServiceAlternative: Free. Software that decides things about people has legal obligations that no amount of testing addresses, and we would rather you heard that early.
